ask: Put our spring menu tour on YouTube, unlisted for now: https://cdn.example.com/spring-tour.mp4

arguments.content: A walk through the new dishes on our spring menu.

steps.why: YouTube needs a video from a public link the user gave. The text becomes the description unless one is set.

The decision: unlisted, as the user asked, so only people with the link can watch for now. Always a title: an empty one is cut from the text. Privacy defaults to private, so it must be set; the details call refuses a misspelling. self_declared_made_for_kids is the kids answer YouTube gets: a menu tour isn't made for children. Add thumbnail_url only if the user gave a public image link.

say: Saved to Acme as a YouTube draft: 'Spring menu tour', unlisted, not for kids. Nothing goes up yet. Schedule it?
never: Leaving privacy unsaid: a video saved without it goes up private.
Choosing a category the user didn't agree to.
A thumbnail_url the user didn't give.
